items.title: Infosys Q2 results preview: Will the results provide oomph to surging IT stocks?
items.description: Infosys is set to report an 11% rise in year-on-year revenues and an 8% increase in net profits. However, the company may lower its full-year revenue outlook due to declining discretionary spending and mounting pricing challenges. Analysts foresee sequential revenue growth driven by acquisitions and enhanced operating margins. The upcoming earnings report will be pivotal, offering valuable insights into client expenditures and potential recovery in demand.

items.title: Aditya Birla AMC Q2 net profit dips 8.4% to Rs 221 crore
items.description: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC witnessed an 8.4% decrease in net profit for the September quarter of FY27, coming in at ₹221 crore, down from ₹241.32 crore last year. In contrast, operational revenue grew by 5% to ₹484 crore. The company faced a 21% increase in total expenses, which rose to ₹230 crore. Significantly, the Quarterly Average Assets Under Management reached ₹4.42 lakh crore, reflecting a 4% year-on-year increase.

items.title: Adani Energy Q2 Results: Profit zooms 148% YoY to Rs 1,323 crore; revenue jumps 53%
items.description: Adani Energy Q2 Results: Revenue from operations in the reporting period rose 53% YoY to Rs 10,076 crore.

items.title: CreditAccess Grameen Q2 profit jumps fourfold to Rs 502 crore
items.description: CreditAccess Grameen reported a fourfold rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 502 crore, driven by higher income, lower expenses and credit costs. Improved asset quality prompted upward revisions to profitability guidance, while assets under management grew 19.5%.

items.title: Hatsun Agro Product Q2 Results: Profit rises 5.6% on strong sales
items.description: Hatsun Agro Product reported a notable growth in net profit for the September quarter, reaching Rs 115.69 crore, up from Rs 109.54 crore from last year. Total income also surged to Rs 2,902.49 crore, showcasing strong sales amidst industry hurdles. The company emphasizes enhancing direct consumer relationships and expanding its market footprint in Maharashtra and Odisha, while continuing to invest in its procurement, processing, and distribution systems.

items.title: Colgate-Palmolive India Q2 Results: Profit rises 4.3% to Rs 341.6 crore
items.description: Colgate-Palmolive India Ltd has reported a 4.3% increase in net profit for the September quarter. The company achieved a net profit of Rs 341.57 crore compared to Rs 327.51 crore last year. Sales increased by 12.22% to Rs 1,691.57 crore in this quarter. The gross margin expanded by 40 basis points year-on-year, reflecting cost management strategies and pricing actions.

items.title: HPCL Q2 Results: Profit slips 6% YoY to Rs 3,625 crore, revenue jumps 26%
items.description: HPCL reported Q2FY27 net profit of Rs 3,625 crore, recovering from a previous-quarter loss. Revenue rose 26.1% year-on-year, refining margins surged, fuel sales increased, and investments advanced infrastructure expansion, innovation, and green energy initiatives.

items.title: Mahindra Lifespace Q2 profit down 66 pc to Rs 16 cr
items.description: Mahindra Lifespace Developers Ltd experienced a substantial 66 percent drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 2026, with profits falling to Rs 16.34 crore compared to Rs 47.91 crore last year. However, total income saw remarkable growth, reaching Rs 104.02 crore, up from Rs 33.06 crore. For the first half of this fiscal year, net profit saw a minor uptick to Rs 101.

items.title: Adani Total Gas Q2 Results: Net profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 173 crore, revenue jumps 34%
items.description: Adani Total Gas Q2 Results: Adani Total Gas reported a 5.9% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 173.27 crore, while revenue from operations climbed 33.8% to Rs 2,109.65 crore. EBITDA grew 12% YoY, supported by higher CNG and PNG volumes and continued expansion of its city gas distribution network.

items.title: Tata Motors CV Q2 Results Preview: Profit may rise up to 44% YoY, revenue 45%; margins, volume growth in focus
items.description: Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles is expected to post strong Q2FY27 revenue and profit growth, driven by 43% volume expansion. However, rising input costs, margin pressures and divergent brokerage estimates remain key investor concerns ahead of results and management commentary.

items.title: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Q2 Results: Net profit rises over 10% YoY to Rs 546 crore, NII jumps 5%
items.description: Jammu & Kashmir Bank reported a 10.6% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 546.4 crore. Operating profit increased 26.7%, while asset quality improved, with gross NPA falling to 2.23%. Advances grew 23.7% to Rs 1.34 lakh crore, and deposits rose 16.3% to Rs 1.77 lakh crore.

items.title: Swiggy Q2 Results: Loss narrows YoY to Rs 922 crore; revenue jumps 36%
items.description: Swiggy Q2 Result: Food delivery and quick commerce company Swiggy Ltd on Thursday said its consolidated profit after tax narrowed to Rs 922 crore in the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 1,092 crore in the same quarter of last year. However, on a sequential basis, losses increased from Rs 792 crore posted in the preceding June quarter.
